newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch gas sales fall 15 percent in first half 1997.
newsitem.headline: Dutch gas sales fall 15 percent in first half 1997.

text.p: Dutch natural gas distributor Gasunie said on Thursday its sales in the first half of 1997 were 14.8 percent lower than in the same period of 1996.
Sales in the first half amounted to 45.5 billion cubic metres (bcm), against 53.4 bcm in the first half of 1996.
The greatest decline was in export sales which fell by 17.8 percent to 21.8 bcm.

Domestic sales fell by 11.8 percent to 23.7 bcm. Sales to regional distribution companies and power stations fell, but industrial consumers bought slightly more gas than in the first half of 1996. This year's winter was milder than the previous one.
In June, sales totalled 4.2 bcm, compared with 4.4 bcm in June 1996. Domestic sales were steady at 2.3 bcm, while exports dipped to 1.9 bcm from 2.1 bcm.
Gasunie is 50 percent owned by the Dutch state and 25 percent each by Royal Dutch/Shell and Exxon Corp unit Esso.
